##### Project general facts

Aquamarine III is a boutique collection of private villas by Breig Property that combines contemporary architecture with a practical, family-oriented layout. The villas are planned over several levels in three- and four-bedroom configurations, with the kitchen and dining area designed as the heart of the home and a cosy lounge that opens onto the outdoor spaces.

Each villa has its own swimming pool and garden on the ground level, while the rooftop terrace holds a second private pool and a lounge area for relaxing in the open air. A private car space at the entrance completes the layout, making the villas comfortable both for owners and for guests.

Interiors mix natural materials with chic industrial finishes, and every bedroom comes with its own bathroom. The villas are handed over fully equipped and furnished, right down to the decor and carefully selected plants, so they are ready to live in or rent out from the very first day.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Canggu is a coastal area on the southwest coast of Bali where rice paddies meet the ocean, with Pererenan on its quieter western edge. The neighbourhood keeps a relaxed Balinese atmosphere while offering some of the island's well-known surf breaks along its beaches.

Daily life is supported by a wide choice of cafes, restaurants, beach clubs and boutique shops serving local and international cuisine. Open-air venues and boutiques are spread across the area, giving residents both convenience and variety close to home.

Canggu and Pererenan are among the most popular places in Bali for holiday stays, with accommodation ranging from guesthouses to luxury villas. This steady demand from surfers, families and long-stay visitors makes villas in the area attractive both as a private retreat and as a rental asset.
